ios.desc:
Altrillio listens to your voice and tells you, honestly, whether you produced a rolled R. No grading. No guesswork. Just yes or no.

Built for adults learning Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, German, Russian — anyone whose target language uses a rolled R. The feedback is real-time, runs entirely on your iPhone, and works regardless of which word or language you attempt.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Practice — tap, attempt a rolled R, get an honest verdict the moment you stop
• Five exercises — drills that build the underlying skill, in order
• Camera mirror — optional, watch your own mouth while you practice
• Personal best — your longest sustained trill, kept locally

PRIVACY FIRST
Audio is processed only on your iPhone. Nothing is recorded, uploaded, stored, or transmitted. No account, no cloud, no analytics.

ONE-TIME PRICE
$9.99 once. No subscription, no ads, no in-app purchases.

NOT MEDICAL
Altrillio is a self-practice tool. It is not speech therapy and not a medical device. For diagnosed speech difficulties, please consult a licensed speech-language pathologist.
